diagnosis.summary: payment-service is returning 5xx errors on every request, with p95 latency up from 4.51 ms to 1928 ms. order-service, which calls payment-service on every order submission, is absorbing that failure: 48.2% of its requests are now 5xx and its p95 latency has risen from 25.1 ms to 1944 ms. The incident has been active for 3 minutes.
diagnosis.root_cause: A complete failure inside payment-service, active concurrently with the resulting elevated errors and latency in order-service, is the most likely root cause. payment-service's own error_rate_5xx is 1.0 and its p95_latency_ms has risen ~428x, while its lambda_duration_ms_mean rose only ~2.2x, indicating the bulk of the latency is not in the handler execution time as measured.
evidence: payment-service is returning a 5xx on every request: error_rate_5xx is 1.0 (up from a baseline of 0).
payment-service p95 end-to-end latency rose from 4.51 ms to 1928 ms, an increase of approximately 428x its baseline.
order-service recorded 106 dependency errors per minute against payment-service, up from a baseline of 0.
order-service's p95 time spent calling payment-service rose from 22.15 ms to 1942.59 ms (~87.7x baseline), closely matching payment-service's own p95 latency of 1928 ms.
order-service error_rate_5xx is now 48.2%, up from a baseline of 0, while p95 latency rose from 25.1 ms to 1944 ms (~77.5x baseline).
payment-service lambda_duration_ms_mean rose only from 0.59 ms to 1.31 ms (~2.2x) despite p95 end-to-end latency reaching 1928 ms.
recommended_actions: Check payment-service CloudWatch Logs at /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-payment for errors, panics, or timeout messages in the current window to identify what is failing inside the handler.
Inspect payment-service lambda_throttle_count in CloudWatch to determine whether Lambda throttling is contributing to the 100% error rate and dependency error count.
Review payment-service cold_start_count: cold starts appear in order-service's dependency call time but not in payment-service's own lambda_duration_ms, which could explain the latency gap.
After identifying and fixing the payment-service fault, recheck dependency_error_count and order-service error_rate_5xx to confirm recovery before making further changes.
Do not add retries to order-service's call to payment-service while payment-service is at 100% error rate, as each retry would add additional invocations and extend latency for waiting clients.
